# glinet_lan_static_lease (Resource)

Manages a DHCP static IP binding of the LAN. The router keeps one binding for each MAC address and one for each IP address, so create and update fail when another binding has the same MAC address or IP address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_lan_static_lease" "printer" {
  mac  = "02:00:00:00:00:01"
  ip   = "192.168.8.201"
  name = "printer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) IPv4 address that the router gives to the client.
- `mac` (String) MAC address of the client, in lower case, for example `02:00:00:00:00:01`. Changing it replaces the binding.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the binding.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the MAC address in lower case.
terraform import glinet_lan_static_lease.printer 02:00:00:00:00:01
```
